title: Temple of Water
objective: Watch the pipeline: read the three pillars, tune alerts and respond to incidents calmly.
intro: The Water Sage can hear every ripple in production. Ganonix drowns teams in noise. Clear five chambers to hear clearly again.

trials.title: The Three Pillars
trials.prompt: Match each observability signal to what it tells you.
trials.hint: Logs are events, metrics are numbers over time, traces follow one request.
trials.success: Logs, metrics and traces: you can see inside the system.

pairs.right: The path of one request across services
Notices when a limit is at risk

trials.title: The Rising Tide
trials.prompt: Production is failing. Put the incident response in order.
trials.hint: Notice, assess, stop the damage, fix the cause, then learn.
trials.success: Calm and in order, the flood recedes.

items.text: Detect the problem from an alert
Mitigate with a rollback or failover

trials.title: The Noisy Alarms
trials.prompt: On-call is exhausted. Flag the alert rules that cause noise instead of action.
trials.hint: An alert should be urgent, real and worth waking someone up for.
trials.success: Pages that fire on blips or for everyone get ignored. Alert on what users feel.
lines: Heartbeat: every 30s -> page the whole company

trials.title: The Dashboard Grotto
trials.prompt: Decide what belongs on the service dashboard.
trials.hint: Show what users feel and give responders a next step. Skip vanity numbers.
trials.success: A dashboard that answers 'is it healthy?' at a glance.
clues: Latency and error rate show what users feel.
A dashboard should link to the runbook that explains what to do.
Counting lines of code shipped says nothing about service health.

trials.title: The Error Budget
trials.prompt: Your service has used up its error budget for the month. What should the team do?
trials.hint: An empty error budget means reliability needs attention before new features.
trials.success: Pause risky changes and spend time on reliability.

options.text: Keep shipping features at full speed.
options.why: That spends reliability you no longer have.

options.text: Raise the target so the budget looks healthy.
options.why: Moving the goalposts hides the problem.

options.text: Slow risky releases and invest in reliability work.
